findings.evidence: "This workspace holds 3 projects, synced last week." is followed by a list containing only "Data Warehouse Cutover" and "Mobile App Revamp"
findings.fix: Either correct the stated count to 2 or add the missing third project to the list.
findings.location: workspace-overview section, "Your projects" intro paragraph and the list beneath it
findings.violation: The text states there are 3 projects but only 2 are listed, so the count and the visible list contradict each other.

findings.fix: Add visible label text such as "Duplicate project" inside the button element.
findings.location: project-settings section, the button directly below the save form
findings.violation: This button has no visible text and no aria-label, so a user or screen reader has no way to know what action it performs.

findings.evidence: "You can restore it at any time from the archived projects list."
findings.fix: Add a linked archived-projects section, or remove the claim if that view is not part of this flow.
findings.violation: The document contains no section or link for an "archived projects list", so this points users to a destination that does not exist anywhere in the document.

findings.evidence: "An invite was sent to the address entered above."
findings.fix: Display the specific email address that was submitted instead of referring back to a prior screen.
findings.violation: The confirmation is a separate section reached by following a link, so there is no "above" for the reader to refer back to, and the actual email address is never shown.

findings.fix: Replace with a specific date and time, for example "synced on July 24, 2026".
findings.violation: "Last week" is a vague relative time that does not tell the reader the actual date or time of the sync.

findings.fix: Add a "Never" or "Off" option to the digest frequency list.
findings.violation: There is no option to turn notifications off, so a user who wants no digest at all has no way to express that choice.

findings.fix: Add the "required" attribute to the email input.
findings.violation: The field has no "required" attribute, so the invite form can be submitted with a blank email address.
